name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A composable color picker. ColorPicker holds the color and shares it with parts laid out in any way: ColorPickerTrigger and ColorPickerContent (a popover), ColorPickerPanel (a column of controls, or a standalone inline picker), ColorPickerSlider (any channel of OKLCH, HSL, HSB or RGB, horizontal or vertical, painted with the colors it reaches), ColorPickerSwatches (presets, Tailwind's palette by default), ColorPickerSwatch, ColorPickerPreview and ColorPickerFixContrast; useColorPicker reads and sets the color from custom parts. Given a background (contrastWith), every part shows contrast: tracks hatch what fails AA and mark the AA/AAA thresholds, presets failing AA are hatched, the preview shows the WCAG ratio and "Fix to AA/AAA" jumps to the nearest passing lightness keeping the hue. Without children, ColorPicker is a swatch that opens OKLCH lightness, chroma and hue sliders in a popover.
